title: Disney Villains
description: The bad guys — names, sidekicks, voice cast.

questions.prompt: Who is the sea witch villain in The Little Mermaid?
questions.explanation: The half-octopus sorceress tricks Ariel into trading her voice for legs in The Little Mermaid (1989).

questions.prompt: Who voiced Scar in The Lion King (1994)?
questions.explanation: Irons' silky menacing delivery on 'Be Prepared' became one of the most quoted villain performances in Disney history.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Maleficent's pet raven?
questions.explanation: In the original 1959 Sleeping Beauty, Diablo serves as Maleficent's spy and is turned to stone by the good fairies.

questions.prompt: What is the villain's full name in 101 Dalmatians?
questions.explanation: Her name is a pun on 'cruel devil' and she wants the puppies skinned to make a spotted fur coat.

questions.prompt: Who is the villain in Sleeping Beauty?
questions.explanation: The self-styled Mistress of All Evil curses Princess Aurora and transforms into a giant dragon in the 1959 film's climax.

questions.prompt: Who is Jafar's wisecracking parrot in Aladdin?
questions.explanation: Voiced by Gilbert Gottfried in Aladdin (1992), his name nods to the scheming villain of Shakespeare's Othello.

questions.prompt: Who is the villain in Tangled?
questions.explanation: She kidnaps Rapunzel as a baby and uses the magic of her golden hair to stay youthful for centuries in Tangled (2010).

questions.prompt: What is Captain Hook's first name in Peter Pan?
questions.explanation: He was originally James Bartholomew Hook in J.M. Barrie's lore, before losing his hand to the crocodile.

questions.prompt: Who is the shadow-summoning villain in The Princess and the Frog?
questions.explanation: The voodoo bokor of New Orleans owes a debt to his 'friends on the other side' in The Princess and the Frog (2009).

questions.prompt: Who is the villain in Hercules?
questions.explanation: The fast-talking lord of the Underworld plots to overthrow Zeus and rule Olympus in Hercules (1997).

questions.prompt: Who voiced Hades in Hercules (1997)?
questions.explanation: Woods improvised so much of Hades' rapid-fire dialogue that he has reprised the role in nearly every Disney sequel and series since.

questions.prompt: What does the Evil Queen demand from the Huntsman in Snow White?
questions.explanation: She orders it brought back in a jeweled box as proof of the kill, but the Huntsman spares Snow White and substitutes a pig's heart.

questions.prompt: Who is the arrogant villain in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: The vain hunter leads a mob to kill the Beast and falls from the castle tower in Beauty and the Beast (1991).

questions.prompt: Who voiced Ursula in The Little Mermaid (1989)?
questions.explanation: Carroll based the voice partly on a witchy theatrical persona; Ursula's look was inspired by drag performer Divine.

questions.prompt: Who is the twist villain in Frozen (2013)?
questions.explanation: The thirteenth-in-line prince of the Southern Isles woos Anna only to seize Arendelle's throne for himself.

questions.prompt: Who is the witch villain in The Emperor's New Groove?
questions.explanation: Emperor Kuzco's scheming advisor turns him into a llama with a botched potion in The Emperor's New Groove (2000).

questions.prompt: What is the name of Yzma's hulking sidekick?
questions.explanation: The sweet-natured henchman talks to squirrels, makes spinach puffs, and has a shoulder angel and devil who argue over his choices.

questions.prompt: Who is the Hun villain in Mulan?
questions.explanation: The brutal Hun leader invades China with his army and is defeated by Mulan with fireworks atop the Imperial Palace in Mulan (1998).

questions.prompt: What is Gaston's loyal sidekick called?
questions.explanation: His name literally means 'the fool' in French and he leads the tavern crowd in the song 'Gaston.'

questions.prompt: What is the villain's name in The Hunchback of Notre Dame?
questions.explanation: The Parisian judge obsessed with Esmeralda sings 'Hellfire' in Disney's 1996 adaptation of the Victor Hugo novel.
